topic.source_contract: Mineral Safeguarding Areas, Mineral Consultation Areas, resource sterilisation, prior extraction and safeguarded infrastructure evidence

facts.purpose: avoid needless sterilisation of mineral resources
facts.process: MSAs, MCAs, local plans and consultation roles separated

facts.guidance: good-practice basis for defining and implementing safeguarding

facts.guard: resource map does not prove recoverable reserve or planning acceptability

scope_guards: An MSA or MCA is not treated as evidence that extraction will occur.
A BGS resource map is not treated as a measured reserve or commercially viable deposit.
Prior extraction policy is not treated as a completed extraction scheme.
Mineral authority consultation is not treated as planning permission.
Mineral planning permission and environmental permits are kept separate.
Safeguarded wharves, railheads and processing sites are not treated as available capacity.
Coal mining legacy constraints are not conflated with mineral safeguarding policy.
No score or promotion is written without exact MSA/MCA, resource assessment, authority response, permissions and delivery evidence.
